resources.string: Everything BoarLite knows is inside this app. Nothing is downloaded.
Checking what is already on this phone…
This copy of BoarLite was built without its data (the language model and the knowledge packs), and BoarLite never downloads anything. Install the full BoarLite APK, which carries everything.
Testers: copy a staged bundle (scripts/stage-bundle.sh) to the phone from a computer, then tap Check again:
BoarLite needs {{needed}} free to unpack its data, and this phone has {{free}} free. Free some space, then try again.
